title: cases.case_opened
description: A customer case was raised and routed. Rules escalate by priority, category or queue.

timestamp.description: When the fact was published, in UTC.

case_reference.description: The case's reference, as the case screens and API show it.

category.description: The tenant's own category code for the case.

channel.description: How the case came in: phone, email, store, chat...

queue_code.description: The code of the queue the case was routed to.

subject_id.description: The customer the fact concerns. Read them with GET /subjects/{id}.
